slug: 2026-07-15 Senegal digitizes more than 15 million birth records in civil registration overhaul

facts.fact: Figures released by ANEC on 15 July 2026 give 67% of civil-status centres as digitised through the Civil Registration Management Software (LGEC), while stating that 629 centres are connected to the national civil-registration network; no count of digitised centres is given.

The National Civil Registration Agency (ANEC) runs the modernisation, with 3,695 registration officers and staff trained by 15 July 2026 and a data-verification campaign in Fatick, Louga and Diourbel from 13 to 29 July 2026.
ANEC reported on 15 July 2026 more than 15.3 million civil-registration records digitised, 67% of centres on the LGEC and a verification campaign under way in three regions from 13 to 29 July 2026.
